purpose: Deliver and test local structure import, explicit user-controlled standard-protein preparation, bounded opt-in short loop construction, and saved TIP3P preview reuse. Functional and numerical software checks only; no claim of experimental loop accuracy, pKa prediction, correct native rotamers, equilibrated solvent or scientific MD results.

reproducibility.scope: Existing source file is retained; new remote imports must retain original response bytes, source identifiers, dates and hashes.
reproducibility.exclusions: Temporary isolated datasets and solvent arrays were removed after checks. Worker inputs, coordinate PDBs, metadata, status, logs and small XML/CSV outputs are retained in preparation-worker-evidence. Full trajectory DCD/NPZ arrays are not retained for these one-step audit jobs; their finite coordinate, timestamp and atom-count assertions are recorded. App jobs themselves retain the full output bundle.

data.policy: Preserve original sequence metadata and atom identity; do not infer residue identities from numbering gaps. Missing-residue building must be opt-in and based on explicit sequence evidence; rebuilt coordinates labeled modeled/uncertain. Protonation edits must be explicit, recorded and carried through engines without silent reset. Solvent preview must use exact retained coordinates for subsequent simulation, without double solvation. SMILES/source molecular states retain stereochemical and conformer provenance.
data.accepted_model_geometry: All current accepted checked fixtures meet finite-coordinate, backbone-gap, and targeted stereocenter checks. Invalid attempted loop models are explicitly rejected before dataset publication; their failure evidence is retained.

validation.scope: Independent source, geometry, preservation, rejection and tiny end-to-end runtime checks, not validation of native molecular geometry.
validation.accepted_positive_loop: ALA28 gap in synthetic 1UBQ26–30; seed2026; sidechain optimization disabled;92atoms;expected CA/ILE-CB signs and no long gap;explicit low-confidence warning.
validation.periodic_continuation: 3485atoms,2frames0–0.002ps;exact saved first-frame coordinates;box preserved;no new atoms;output preparation/solvation markers and GROMACS guard retained.
historical_findings_resolved: MOL2 interleaved atom blocks fail clearly before storage
mmCIF long-chain and label/auth sequence mappings preserved
Improper PDBFixer template alignments constrained to det+1; stereochemistry guards reject later invalid models
Simulation outputs retain exact first-frame state and preparation/solvation markers
validation.runtime_caveat: The ILE3 loop attempt and optional relaxation of the ALA-gap fixture remain unsuitable and are rejected; a successful alternative does not validate their accuracy.
validation.backend_tests: 48 passed, 2 deprecation warnings in2.00s; actual output docs/audit/preparation-backend-tests.txt

comparison.notes: No scientific method comparison or accuracy claim. No uncertainty intervals or prospective/experimental validation. Generic postflight scientific-promotion gate remains unresolved by software tests.

review_identity: Language-model implementation/evidence review; PatAgent is an automated public-writing-inspired checklist, not Pat Walters or expert certification.

modeling.notes: Only two one-step continuation checks and small preparation fixtures. No equilibrium estimates or production MD conclusions.

known_limitations: Protein presets support standard amino-acid chemistry only; arbitrary ligand/nucleic parameterization remains external.
GROMACS explicitly rejects DynaMol-prepared or solvent-preview states until a validated naming/state conversion exists.
Short loop construction is opt-in, bounded, sequence-supported, low-confidence, and can fail geometry checks.
Stereocenter, gap and finite-coordinate checks are necessary but insufficient to establish native-loop or sidechain accuracy.
The local chi search is one bounded steric heuristic, not empirical rotamer packing; optional relaxation may be rejected for geometry defects.
pH assignment is heuristic/template-based and does not calculate site-specific pKa or constant-pH equilibria.
TIP3P previews are unequilibrated, fixed boxes; PDB reuse introduces standard coordinate rounding up to0.00005nm.
The scoped PDBFixer private-helper override requires revalidation when the dependency changes.
